name: sand1
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a pixel-art master sheet of SANDSTORM airborne dust swirls for a top-down RPG. Pure solid #FF00FF magenta background. Exactly six separate horizontal sprites, arranged 2 columns by 3 rows with huge magenta gutters. Each sprite designed as about 28 to 44 native pixels wide and 8 to 14 native pixels high, enlarged hugely into crisp square blocks. These are BROKEN TAPERING CLUSTERS of ochre dust caught in wind: uneven thickness, a broad granular middle dissolving into a few shorter angular wisps, open magenta channels between connected clusters, asymmetrical loose eddies. Six different lengths, widths and curling shapes. Flat warm golden ochre, muted amber, light sandy gold, very restrained pale highlights. AVOID continuous bright outlines, long continuous cords, lightning zigzags, ropes, waves, flame tips, fully enclosed loops, brown mud, fog clouds, rounded puffs, scattered isolated specks, dots or noise. Pixel clusters must be connected and square stepped. Top-left light. No blur, gradient, antialiasing, text, grid, frames, terrain. Keep shapes compact and broken, gaps reaching into each swirl; do NOT draw long ribbons across the image. This is a carefully drawn large master to mode-reduce onto native square pixels.

name: sand2
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel art sandstorm dust master atlas on flat pure magenta #FF00FF. Exactly SIX isolated sprites, TWO columns THREE rows, ample gutters, no labels. Alternative designs: gently twisting windblown sand, long fractured patches with empty gaps, each a few overlapping thin ragged angular strokes that broaden in one off-centre spot and taper away. Native size about 32x10 pixels, drawn very large with visible square pixel blocks. Restrained four flat tones: muted ochre, sandy gold, pale tan and small pale straw highlights. No outlines around the swirls and NO continuous white or cream edging. Broken contour and open internal magenta channels. Less curling than a wave; sideways gentle sweeping dust almost parallel to the ground. Vary every silhouette and thickness; short detached multi-pixel wisps are okay, isolated single specks are not. Texture is chunky connected grit, not dithering, not noise. NO thick cloud blobs, rounded puffs, smoke, fire, golden surf, long rope-like strands, lightning, scenery, panels, gradients, blur or antialias. It should read as airy moving golden dust at tiny pixel scale. A drawing master for mode reduction, not a finished weather field.

name: wind1
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel-art BLIZZARD wind streak master atlas on absolutely solid pure magenta #FF00FF. SIX separate wind strokes arranged TWO columns THREE rows, huge clear gutters, no labels. Each stroke is one continuous one-pixel thick stepped strand at its native intended size of 14 to 24 pixels wide and 2 to 3 pixels high. Render each native pixel as a LARGE SQUARE BLOCK so each strand remains connected after mode reduction. Mostly horizontal left-to-right stroke with ONE shallow step upward or downward through its length, a short two-pixel-wide tail end. Some are doubled for three pixels near their left end. NO tall curls or hollow loops. Shapes are connected from left endpoint to right endpoint. Off-white/icy white with occasional pale blue-grey square in lower-right, flat three-colour palette. Crisp orthogonal square edges, very simple understated shape, top-left light. Wind-whipped snow tracers for a top-down 48px-grid game. NOT floating dashes, disconnected dots, huge snowflake icons, waves, lightning, arrows, tapering curves, cloud puffs, fog, airbrush, gradients, blur, antialias, scenery. Exact six large separate drawing masters, not a finished weather field.

name: wind2
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Six isolated enlarged pixel-art blizzard wind strand designs on flat #FF00FF magenta. 2 columns 3 rows with large empty gutters. Each is a thin connected line of giant SQUARE pixels, native width 12, 16, 20, 24, 18, 14 pixels respectively and native height only 2 pixels. Continuous horizontal one-pixel strand with a SINGLE gentle step of one pixel in height somewhere through it. Different location of the step for each. Three flat colors, off-white with short ice-blue-grey section at lower right. Like subtle thin traces of fast sideways blowing snow, consistent hard square pixels. Do not break a strand into disconnected dashes. No curves, no hooks, no arrows, no multiple zigzags, no thick rectangular chunks, no spearheads, no cloud or fog, no noise, no transparency or shading gradients, no blur, no text, no grid. Draw the strokes very large so the simple shapes can be mode-reduced into clean 1-pixel-thick game wind strokes.

name: splash
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw exactly TWO miniature pixel-art rain splash ticks hugely enlarged on pure solid magenta #FF00FF, side by side, centred with large gutters. Left mark: a single horizontal domino of TWO square pixels, the left pale icy white and the right muted blue-grey. Right mark: TWO pale icy blue square pixels touching only diagonally, one lower-left, one upper-right, like a tiny kicked-up rain splash. All giant square blocks, exact straight edges, no rounded edges. Each enlarged square block is about 140x140 pixels, plenty magenta. Absolutely no other pixels, no drops, no arcs, no borders, no dark shadow around the marks, no highlights smaller than a square block, no text, labels, noise, blur, gradient or antialias. These careful drawing masters will be mode-reduced to two-pixel splash marks. Flat two-color palette, pure magenta is empty background.
